# Wonder World Kids Learning

> Interactive Early Childhood Learning Marketplace: 45 Offline Educational Games Across 5 Worlds + Printable Colouring & Activity Workbooks (Ages 3–8)

Canonical URL: https://wonderworldkidslearning.space
Support Email: wonderworldkidslearning@gmail.com
Extended Knowledge Context: https://wonderworldkidslearning.space/llms-full.txt
XML Sitemap: https://wonderworldkidslearning.space/sitemap.xml

## Core Offerings
- **Wonder World Kids Learning App**: 45 ad-free, 100% offline educational mini-games across 5 interactive worlds (225 progressive levels, up to 4 local child profiles, COPPA & GDPR-K safe). One-time lifetime family license ($9.00 USD on Gumroad, zero subscriptions).
- **Printable Colouring & Early Learning Workbooks (Digital PDF)**:
  - Dinosaur World Colouring Book (30 printable pages, ages 3–5)
  - ABC Alphabet Activity Book (phonics, tracing & vocabulary, ages 3–8)
  - Christmas Wonderland Colouring Book (30 seasonal pages, ages 3–8)
  - My First Maths Adventure Printable Book (counting, shapes & addition, ages 3–8)

## Supported Offline Devices & Platforms
- Apple Mac (macOS Safari / Chrome PWA)
- Apple iPhone & iPad (iOS / iPadOS Safari Add to Home Screen)
- Android Phones & Tablets (Chrome / Edge PWA)
- Windows PC & Chromebook (Chrome / Edge PWA)
